actions.action: Water the plant the day before repotting
Buy a pot one size up with drainage holes
Buy standard potting mix with perlite or pumice
Remove plant, loosen outer roots, trim up to a third if dense and remove mushy roots
Repot with fresh soil keeping trunk flare at same level, press and water thoroughly
Keep out of direct harsh sun for 1-2 weeks after repotting
Water when top inch of soil is dry
Optionally top-dress with fresh soil as a stopgap

reason: The answer's main recommendation is repotting in regular potting soil without changing the soil height, matching the confirmed fix, and it advises nothing likely to harm the plant.
